Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. Bangladesh have sealed the series but the last ODI of the series won't be a dead-rubber, as there are 10 crucial points up for grab. Will the hosts be able to complete the whitewash? Or will Afghanistan end up stealing some points? To find out, do join us on Monday, 28th February. The first ball will be bowled at 1030 IST (0500 GMT). But as you all know, you can join us early for the buildup. Till then take care and goodbye!

Tamim Iqbal, the victorious skipper of Bangladesh, is in for a chat. He says, the partnership that Liton Das and Mujeeb Ur Rahman created was beautiful and they built a solid stand for them. Mentions, the bowlers did really well to seal the game. Adds, even though they have won the series the next game is still important with 10 points up for grabs. Ends by saying, till the time the momentum is on their side, they will look to make the most of it.
Liton Das is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his outstanding knock of 136 runs.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan, says that they gave some extra runs at the start and that might’ve released the pressure off Bangladesh. Mentions, they gave away a lot of extras with the ball and that hurt them a lot. Says, that he hopes that his side will work on it and perform well in the next game.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

Bangladesh's bowlers had plenty of runs to play with and they started off really well. A total of 7 bowlers were used by Tamim Iqbal and each of them got into the wickets column. Shoriful Islam bowled well at the start but it was the fiery spell of Taskin Ahmed in the middle overs which completely turned the tide in Bangladesh's favor. He provided his team a much-needed breakthrough and Bangladesh never looked back from that point. Taskin along with Shakib Al Hasan were the pick of the bowlers. Shakib took two wickets and gave away just 38 runs. All in all, it was a dominant display from Bangladesh's bowlers but not to forget the efforts of Liton Das and Mushfiqur Rahim in the first innings that set the game up for them.

Afghanistan lost three wickets inside the Powerplay while chasing a target of over 300 and it was always going to be a challenge for them going ahead in the chase. The pair of Rahmat Shah and Najibullah Zadran did steady their ship somewhat as they went on to stitch a partnership of 89 runs. Although, they failed to convert their fifties into a big one and that cost them the match. Once this stand was broken, things went downhill for Afghanistan and their innings never really got going post that. Mohammad Nabi and Rashid Khan did show some fight in the end, but 307 proved to be too much for the tourists and they were handed a comprehensive defeat.

A commanding victory for Bangladesh and they not only seal the ODI series but also grab 10 crucial points in the World Cup Super League. Chasing a target of over 300 runs was always going to be a tough ask for a team like Afghanistan and they never really looked like doing so. A clinical performance from the hosts and they deserve to win this match as well as the series, with one more game to go.

OUT! TIMBER! Afif Hossain takes only one delivery to pick up the final wicket. Tossed up, full and on off. Fazalhaq Farooqi looks to drive it away but misses. The ball sneaks through the gap and shatters the stumps. BANGLADESH WIN THE GAME BY 88 RUNS.
Quicker, fuller, on the stumps. Fareed Ahmad defends it out.
Around off, fuller, Ahmad gets his blade down and sees off the danger.
Fuller and on off. Ahmad remains solid in his defense.
Full and on off, blocked to cover.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a terrific catch from Mahmudul Hasan Joy (sub) in the deep. Tossed up, on middle. Mujeeb Ur Rahman heaves it high in the night sky towards the deep mid-wicket region. Mahmudul Hasan Joy (sub) there takes the catch just in front of the ropes. He realizes that the momentum is taking him over the ropes so he throws the ball back in play, goes over the ropes, comes back in and catches it with ease. Top effort from the youngster.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Mahmudul Hasan Joy b Mahmudullah

Commentary.Commentary: Fazalhaq Farooqi is the last man in.
Is that a clean catch? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The soft signal is OUT. The replays show Mahmudul Hasan Joy gathers the ball safely in the deep. The big screen displays OUT.

On a length and angling across the batter. Mujeeb Ur Rahman taps it towards backward point. 92 runs needed off 42 balls.
A full ball, outside off. Fareed Ahmad drills it to deep cover for a single.
No ball! Mustafizur Rahman errs in line and serves a full toss, above the batter's waist, outside off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman guides it to third man for a run. Free Hit to follow...
A full ball, on middle. Fareed Ahmad clips it to the leg side for a single.
A slower ball, full and well outside off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman drives it to the man at extra cover who half-stops it and the batters take one run.
Back of a length, around off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman defends it to the off side.
A slower ball, angling across the batter. Mujeeb Ur Rahman tries to cut but he fails to get any bat on it.
This is darted on the pads. Mujeeb Ur Rahman works it through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Tosses it up nicely, around off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman blocks it out.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Mujeeb Ur Rahman nudges it to the leg side and comes back for the second run as there is an overthrow at the keeper's end.
A loopy ball, full and on off. Fareed Ahmad drags it to the leg side and manages only a single.
An arm ball, going on with the arm, around middle. Fareed Ahmad drags it back to the bowler.

A yorker-length ball, on off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman digs it out watchfully.
A slower ball, full and on middle. Mujeeb Ur Rahman drills it back to the bowler.
A length ball, on off. Fareed Ahmad pushes it to mid on for a single.
Fareed Ahmad is the new man in.

FOUR! Another ball, full and outside off. Rashid Khan drives it through the cover region where the fielder misfields and concedes a boundary.
SIX! BANG! A full ball, on middle. Rashid Khan whips it off his pads and sends it sailing way over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
End of Powerplay 2! Bangladesh can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
Fuller, angled down leg. Mujeeb Ur Rahman tucks it to square leg.
Floated, full and on off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman prods and defends it into the deck.
On off, blocked out solidly.
Again the reverse-sweep comes out from Rashid Khan. Worked to point for one more run.
Fuller, on off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman reverse sweeps it to point for one.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman prods and tries to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, on off. Khan defends it out solidly.
FOUR! Nicely played. A full-length ball, on off. Khan drills it through mid on for a boundary. A good looking shot, this.
Good length, outside off. Khan tries to work it to the off side but misses.
LEG BYES! A length ball, on the pads. Mujeeb Ur Rahman glances it down to fine leg off his pads. The fielder fumbles and the batters take a couple.
A length ball, on off, pushed to cover for one.
WIDE! Full length, outside off. Khan looks to chase it but misses. It is outside the tramline and the umpire signals a wide.
On the pads, Mujeeb Ur Rahman flicks it to square leg for a single.
BEATEN! Quicker, fuller, outside off. Mujeeb Ur Rahman leans in and looks to defend it out but misses.
Angled in, full and on leg. Khan nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman walks in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! The patience finally pays off for Bangladesh. Mohammad Nabi tries to break the shackles but holes out instead. Tossed uo, full and on off. Mohammad Nabi advances down the track, throws his blade at it and lofts it towards long off. Afif Hossain settles under it and takes a solid catch. Can Bangladesh end things quickly now?
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Mehidy Hasan

On the pads, Nabi flicks it to square leg for one.
Mehidy Hasan (8-0-46-0) is back on.
A length ball, on off. Nabi pushes it down the ground for one. Nabi and Khan are doing really well to eat up the balls and frustrate the bowlers.
Fuller, on off. Khan pushes it to cover for one.
Length ball, outside off. Khan covers his stumps and taps it to covers.
A short ball, around the hips. Nabi flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Nabi eases it to the off side.
A length ball, on off. Nabi pushes out to safety.
Full length, on the pads. Nabi flicks it to deep square leg for a single. Taskin Ahmed completes his spell of 10 overs by only giving away 31 runs.
Back of a length, outside off. Khan stands tall and cuts it through point for one.
A length ball, outside off. Khan leaves it alone.

In the air...safe! Back of a length, on off. Nabi stands tall and pulls it to deep square leg. Yasir Ali charges towards the ball but realises that he wouldn't be able to get there and smartly dives forward to stop it on a bounce. One taken.
Length ball, on the pads. Khan gets inside the line and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Khan works it to cover off the leading edge.
Good-length delivery, around off. Rashid Khan taps it to the off side and collects a run. 132 runs needed off 90 balls.
BEATEN! Excellent comeback from Islam! This is a length ball, just outside off that jags away late. Rashid Khan looks to poke at it but the ball beats his outside edge.
FOUR! What a shot from the magician! Shoriful Islam serves a half-volley, outside off. Rashid Khan lunges forward and carves it through the cover region for a boundary.
Shoriful Islam comes 'round the wicket and serves a length ball, outside off. Rashid Khan lunges forward to block it.
Back of a length, around middle. Nabi nudges it around the corner and rotates the strike.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Good-length delivery, outside off. Nabi presses forward and lofts it over extra cover to bag a boundary.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Mohammad Nabi punches it down to long off. A single to end the over. Singles are not going to hurt Bangladesh at all!
Slightly shorter and wider, outside off. Rashid Khan cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Tosses it up, around off. Rashid Khan defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mohammad Nabi drills it down to long off for one run.
Floated, on a length, outside off. Mohammad Nabi prods and defends it solidly.
Slower through the air, on off. Nabi pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Nabi defends it to the off side and takes a single.
FOUR! WHACKED! Back of a length, outside off. Mohammad Nabi hangs back and cuts it hard past the point fielder for a boundary.
Uppish but safe! Back of a length, around off. Rashid Khan stays back to punch it through covers but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a run.
This is darted on the pads. Mohammad Nabi tickles it to fine leg and settles for a run.
Back of a length, around off. Rashid Khan taps it to the off side and collects a single.
Good-length ball, around middle and leg. Mohammad Nabi nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
Floated, on a length, around off. Rashid Khan defends it off the front foot.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Rahmanullah Gurbaz's struggle comes to an end. This is a flatter ball, around off. Gurbaz rocks back to cut but he only manages to get a thick inside edge that shatters the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan gets his second wicket and Afghanistan fall in a deeper hole now.
Tossed up, just outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz prods and blocks it.
Pitches it up, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
On a length, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it to the leg side and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to cut but he misses.
A length ball, angling in from off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz prods and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, around off. Mohammad Nabi taps it to the off side and sets off for a quick single.
Short of a length, outside off. Mohammad Nabi cuts it uppishly past the fielder at point for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz cuts it to deep cover for a single.
DRINKS! Well, Bangladesh are all over Afghanistan at the moment. Afghanistan need to bat out of their skins from hereon if they are to get anywhere near the target.
Fuller, on the pads. Gurbaz clips it to square leg for one.
On off, pushed to the off side.

Looped up, on off. Gurbaz pushes it to cover and venture out looking for a signal. A throw comes in to the keeper and the bails are off. Mushfiqur Rahim appeals and the umpire takes it upstairs to have a look. The replays show the batters has his blade inside the crease.

A wicket-maiden for Taskin Ahmed. On a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tries to chase it but misses.

Full length, on off. Gurbaz gets behind the line and defends it out.
BEATEN! Good length, outside off, shaping away off the deck. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shuffles across and tries to have a poke at it. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Full length, on the stumps. Gurbaz defends it back to the bowler.
Rahmanullah Gurbaz walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A big, big wicket for Bangladesh. Taskin Ahmed is celebrating with his own victory lap here. He knows how crucial this wicket is. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran is cramped for room. He sways back and tries to ramp it over the keeper, but he only manages to get a thick outside edge. Mushfiqur Rahim takes an easy catch behind the sticks. Afghanistan slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

On off, blocked out.

Flighted, full and on the pads. Nabi stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket.

Good-length delivery, around off. Najibullah Zadran taps it to the off side and takes a quick single. BACK-TO-BACK FIFTIES for Najibullah Zadran. A gritty knock from him but he would be aware that the job is only half done.
A bit fuller this time, outside off. Najibullah Zadran drives it without much timing towards cover.
Taskin Ahmed comes 'round the wicket and serves it on a length, on off. Najibullah Zadran gets behind the line of the ball to defend.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a peach of a delivery to get rid of Rahmat Shah! Taskin Ahmed runs in and serves a length ball, around off that straightens after landing. Rahmat Shah looks to play inside the line in order to block it. The ball beats his outside edge and just clips the top of off stump. The bails come off and Bangladesh celebrate. The umpire sends it upstairs to confirm the same and it suggests that the ball just clipped the top of off stump. Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.
Is that out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays confirm the bails come off with the help of the ball. The final decision is OUT.
Full, on leg. Shah flicks it to fine leg for one.
FOUR Up and over! A length ball, on off. Shah lofts it over covers to bag a boundary.
This is tossed up, well outside off. Rahmat Shah looks to drive but he misses.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Rahmat Shah keeps it out.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran stays back and cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
Quicker through the air, on middle. Rahmat Shah punches it to long on for a run.

On a length, angling in from outside off. Najibullah Zadran gets cramped for room and manages to punch it back to the bowler.
An off-pace delivery, outside off. Najibullah Zadran mistimes his cut shot towards the extra cover fielder.
This is darted on the pads. Najibullah Zadran nudges it around the corner for a run.

Floated, around middle. Najibullah Zadran tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, on middle. Najibullah Zadran presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Rahmat Shah punches it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Rahmat Shah stays back to defend it.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! A full ball, angling in from leg. Rahmat Shah looks to flick but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and punches it through covers for a single.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Najibullah Zadran prods and taps it towards point.
A length ball, angling across the batter. Rahmat Shah looks to block but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a run.
On a length, around middle. Rahmat Shah drives it back to the bowler.
A length ball, on off. Rahmat Shah defends it out.

Full, on middle and leg. Zadran flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Angled into the pads. Najibullah Zadran prods and blocks it out.
Full and on off. Shah pushes it to cover for a single. 100 up for Afghanistan.

Flatter ball, spinning into the batter. Rahmat Shah tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Shah cuts it wide of deep cover and comes back for the second run.
On a length, around off. Rahmat Shah keeps it out.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Najibullah Zadran slaps it through covers and rotates the strike.
Tossed up, outside off and spinning away late. Najibullah Zadran punches it to the man at extra cover.

NOT OUT! Tossed up, on off. Najibullah Zadran hits it back to the bowler. Shakib Al Hasan gets low but fails to get any hand on it, which he confirms after the wickets are hit at the non-striker's end. The umpire though takes it upstairs to confirm. After several replays the third umpire concludes that the batter is out. This is when Shakib Al Hasan's sportsmanship comes into play and he tells the umpire that he did not touch the ball. He expects the umpire to overturn the decision. The third umpire has a look at it again with several angles, this time there is a conclusive evidence that the ball goes through the palms of Shakib Al Hasan without any contact and in the end Rahmat Shah stays in the middle.

Having said that, the tourists still have a long way to go and they cannot afford to lose any more wickets going ahead.

Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Rahmat Shah cuts it through the point region and Liton Das does well in the deep to keep it to just two.
On a length, on off. Najibullah Zadran works it to long off for a run.
This one comes on with the angle from middle. Najibullah Zadran misses his nudge and gets hit on his pad outside the line.
Floated, on a length, around off. Najibullah Zadran blocks it out.
A loopy ball, outside off. Shah skips down the track and works it to long off for a single.
Tosses it up, around off. Shah keeps it out.
A length ball, around off. Najibullah Zadran defends it to the off side.
FOUR! WHACKED! Back of a length, around off. Zadran stays back and punches it hard through the cover region. Liton Das in the deep runs to his left, puts in a dive but he cannot prevent the boundary.
A bouncer, just outside off this time around. Najibullah Zadran sways away from the line of the ball.
Another ball, banged into the deck, around leg. Zadran ducks underneath yet again.
A short ball, around middle. Najibullah Zadran ducks underneath.
Good-length ball, outside off. Shah prods to block but it goes off the outside edge along the ground towards third man for a run.
End of Powerplay 1! Bangladesh can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over.
Fuller, on leg. Rahmat Shah gets low and sweeps it through square leg for a single. Afghanistan are 36/3 at the end of Powerplay 1. They have a humongous task in front of them.
Floated full, on leg. Zadran eases it down to long on for one.
Full and on the stumps. Najibullah Zadran pushes it to cover.
Around off, defended out.
Slower through the air, around off, turns in with the arm. Najibullah Zadran flicks it to the leg side.
Najibullah Zadran walks out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! A wicket was always on the cards. Shakib Al Hasan strikes and gets his first wicket. Shakib Al Hasan angles in a full ball, on leg. Azmatullah Omarzai comes down the track and looks to heave it away but misses it completely. Mushfiqur Rahim grabs the ball and whips the bails off with ease. Azmatullah Omarzai is way out of the crease and he continues his walk back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: st Mushfiqur Rahim b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on off. Shah pushes it out to covers. Two dots in a row to end the over.
Length ball, on off, Shah pushes it out.

Back of a length, on off. Rahmat Shah pushes it to covers with soft hands. He ventures out looking for a single, while the ball is close to the fielder. The non-striker yells no and Shah is on his way back. Luckily for him the fielder does not score a direct hit.
A length ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah punches it through backward point. They get a couple. Rahmat Shah could not make the most of the width on offer.
A length ball, on off, Rahmat Shah blocks it out.
Full length, on the fourth stump line. Rahmat Shah presses forward and defends it out.
Three dots on the trot! Flatter and on off. Azmatullah Omarzai moves back and punches it to cover. A great start by Shakib Al Hasan, just one run off it.
Flighted, full and on off. Azmatullah Omarzai defends it off the front foot.
Around off, defended to the off side.
Full and on middle. Shah gets low and sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Shah extends his arms but gets it to covers off the inner half.
Floated, full and on off. Rahmat Shah gets behind the line and defends it out.
A slower delivery to end the over. Length and on the stumps. Azmatullah Omarzai gets on top of the ball and defends it into the deck.
Full length, outside off. Shah looks to drive it to the off side. It takes the outside edge and goes towards third man. There is a man in the deep and they only take a single.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Azmatullah Omarzai clears his front leg and flicks it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Short and punished. Back of a length, on off. Azmatullah Omarzai swivels on the back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Afghanistan need more such boundaries.
Swing and a miss! Pressure creeping in now. A good-length ball, outside off, shaping away a bit. Azmatullah Omarzai throws the bat at it but only connects with thin air.
Length, on off, blocked out watchfully.
A length ball, on off. Shah drives it to cover, but not in the gap. Just 5 runs off it. Another good over by Shoriful Islam comes to an end.
Azmatullah Omarzai has been struck on his helmet and the physio is out as a part of the concussion protocol. Omarzai seems to be fine and we are good to go.

LEG BYE! This must've hurt. Shoriful Islam bangs the deck hard, on leg. Azmatullah Omarzai gets beaten by pace and takes a blow on his helmet. The batters collect a leg bye. But Azmatullah Omarzai will receive some treatment.

Direct hit could've been curtains for Azmatullah Omarzai. A length ball, on off. Azmatullah Omarzai pushes it to the left of mid off. Tamim Iqbal moves to that side, collects the ball and throws it straightaway at the non-striker's end. It misses the stumps and Azmatullah Omarzai could get a single off it.

Full length, on the pads. Azmatullah Omarzai flicks it through mid-wicket. They take two before the fielder cuts it out. Afif Hossain was quick enough to get to the ball. Bangladesh fielders have been on the money so far.
A short ball, just outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai cuts it hard to point. Mehidy Hasan collects the ball on a bounce.
A length ball, on off. Azmatullah Omarzai drives it to cover but straight to the fielder. This one comes off the middle but is unable to find the gap.
On a length, around off. Rahmat Shah blocks it to the off side.
A length ball, angling in late from middle. Azmatullah Omarzai looks to keep it out but it goes off the inside half of the bat towards square leg for a single.
Length and on the stumps. Azmatullah Omarzai defends it out solidly.

NOT OUT! A full ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it through the cover region. The fielder at covers chases it and cuts it off. The batters go for the third run. The throw comes in from the deep towards Mushfiqur Rahim who whips the bails off but Azmatullah Omarzai was well in as suggested by the replays.
Is that a run out? The square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show the batter was well inside the crease. The big screen shows NOT OUT!
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah leaves it alone.
A full ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it to the extra cover fielder.
A length ball, on off. Azmatullah Omarzai gets behind the line and defends it to cover. A wicket taking over by Shoriful Islam comes to an end.
Azmatullah Omarzai is the new man in. No signs of Rahmanullah Gurbaz yet.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shoriful Islam gets his man this time and it is the Afghan skipper who walks back to the pavilion. This is a good-length delivery, well outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi hangs back and throws his bat at it to hit it square of the wicket on the off side. The ball takes the outside edge and goes straight to Mushfiqur Rahim behind the sticks who takes a simple catch to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Streaky but Afghanistan will take it as they come! A length ball, just outside off that nips back in sharply. Hashmatullah Shahidi hangs back and looks to push it through covers but it goes off the inside edge past the leg stump and races away to the fence.
Good-length delivery, around off. Rahmat Shah stays back and pushes it to the off side to take a run.
Short of a length, around off. Rahmat Shah defends it to the off side.
Back of a length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi punches it towards point and takes a single.

An appeal for LBW but turned down! A length ball, around off that jags back in late. Rahmat Shah looks to defend but he misses and gets hit on his pad. The ball dies as it goes towards the keeper. Mushfiqur Rahim stops the ball with his foot but before bending down to gather the ball, he is standing tall with both his arm in the air, as he appeals for an lbw. The umpire though is unmoved. Mushfiqur Rahim although asks the skipper to not the take the reviewm as he thnks it was a bit too high. A wise decision as the replays later suggests that the ball was missing the stumps. A maiden over from Taskin Ahmed.
Pitches it up, on middle. Rahmat Shah prods and eases it to mid on.
On a length, around off. Rahmat Shah covers the line of the ball to block it.
Back of a length, around off. Shah stays back to block.
A bit full and outside off. Rahmat Shah looks to drive it through covers but he gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Taskin starts with a length ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah leaves it alone.
Taskin Ahmed comes into the attack now.
A length ball, on the pads. Rahmat Shah tickles it to fine leg and takes a single.
A bit fuller this time, way outside off. Rahmat Shah shoulders arms to this one.
JAFFA! Good-length ball, landing around off and curling away late. Rahmat Shah looks to defend off the back foot but the ball whistles past his outside edge.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rahmat Shah prods and pushes it to cover.
Back of a length, around off, shaping across the right-hander. Rahmat Shah stands inside the crease and shoulders his arms at it.
Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper comes in at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! This is the last thing that Afghanistan would have hoped for! Brilliant piece of fielding from Afif Hossain and Riaz Hassan is a goner! A length ball, on middle. Hassan taps it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a quick run. Afif Hossain runs in from mid-wicket, collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Hassan is caught short of his crease and Bangladesh get the breakthrough.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show Riaz Hassan is short of the crease when the bails were coming off. The big screen shows OUT. The crowd in the stadium has erupted.
Shoriful Islam to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Nicely timed! A full ball, on middle and leg. Shah prods and flicks it through the mid-wicket region. The fielder there gives it a chase but the ball wins. 9 runs off the first over!
Back of a length, around off. Rahmat Shah blocks it out.
An overpitched ball, on off. Rahmat Shah digs it out back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Riaz Hassan hangs back and steers it to third man for a run. Both the openers are off the mark now!
Good-length delivery, around off. Rahmat Shah taps it to the off side and takes a single.
Wide! A full ball, well outside off this time. Rahmat Shah leaves it alone. Wided!
A full ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah leans and drives it through the cover region for a brace. Afghanistan are underway!
